author: sega_jenesis_
title: Hunt for digital artists for Pokémon binder scenes
content: I’m on the hunt for digital artists! I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Obviously, this is a PAID commission! If you’re an artist or know someone who might be interested, please send them my way! I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability.
